method: Local TestClient, 166 shaped personas (+fixture personas), fake source-ingest owner with newest-first pages, 3000 evidence items, 0.2 s per owner request (slow) or unavailable after 0.2 s. 5 runs per cell. Harness: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_quarterly_ranking_read_latency.py helpers.
root_cause: _pm12_public_quarter_evidence_refs called read_evidence_refs() with no page_size, so the port streamed every owner evidence page (EVIDENCE_OWNER_PAGE_SIZE=200) before filtering to the quarter. Cost grew linearly with total owner evidence; on hosted each owner request waits ~4 s.
fix: personas/service.py: quarter evidence read pages the owner newest-first at page_size 500, stopping when the owner is exhausted, a page has no row at/after the quarter start, or _PM12_QUARTER_EVIDENCE_MAX_PAGES=3 is reached; any unavailable page marks the surface unavailable. Context composed once per request. No cache/setting/endpoint/job; port unchanged.

profile_ms_before_after.reproduce: Loop of 5 runs per cell over t._get(t._Owner(3000, unavailable, delay=0.2), route); 'before' sets personas_service._PM12_QUARTER_EVIDENCE_PAGE_SIZE=None (full stream, page 200). Local noisy machine; absolute times ~2x the earlier run.
profile_ms_before_after.per_step_note: Dominant cost before: 15 sequential owner requests x 0.2 s = 3.0 s of ~3.8 s. After: 3 x 0.2 = 0.6 s owner wait plus ~0.7 s compute (earlier cProfile: snapshot digest ~0.28 s, remainder ASGI/serialisation). Unavailable owner: first page fails, 1 wait, unchanged.

notes: Review fix: previous single newest-500 read truncated linked in-quarter evidence (501 vs 500 refs, snapshot id changed). Now parity is tested with 501 linked in-quarter refs, with and without 700 newer post-quarter refs, on all 3 routes.

Residual bounds, stated honestly: owner order is append order (not timestamp), and the owner has no time filter. Output equals the full stream whenever quarter-relevant rows lie within the first 3 pages (1500 newest) and paging was not cut by the early-stop; older late-appended rows beyond that are not attached. Fully exact bounded reads need an owner-side time filter (out of scope: no new endpoint).

Acceptance 4 partial: unavailable owner pays one wait; a slow-but-available owner pays up to 3 waits (cap), down from N=total/200. Acceptance 5 (<1.5 s p50 local) holds for ranking in this run (1.313 s) with 0.2 s owner delay but recommendations is 1.54 s.
persona-league/tiers makes no evidence-owner request locally; not changed by this task and not claimed fixed.

tests.added: test_quarterly_ranking_read_latency.py (15 tests): owner requests constant (<=cap) for 5000/50000 evidence on 3 routes; unavailable paid once; 300-row parity; linked >500 evidence parity (with/without newer refs) on 3 routes.
tests.assertions_changed: none; no existing test weakened or deleted.
